item.description: Offering the best defense against unfriendly asphalt, Eight Ball pads are sleek, comfortable and durable at an affordable price. Triple Eight’s Kneesaver Knee Pads, Elbowsaver Elbow Pads and Wristsaver Wrist Guards, packaged together in a convenient 3-pack. The knee pads and elbow pads are made of high grade durable fabrics, EVA foam padding, and polycarbonate full coverage caps to provide superior protection without restricting movement. The wrist guards offer great support and protection with high density impact-resistant molded ABS splints on front and back of wrists for support. This 3-pack is ideal for inline skating (roller blading), and all roller sports, and a great, convenient way to have all the necessary protective gear. Product details: Includes Wristsavers, Kneesavers, and Elbowsavers. Ideal for inline skating (roller blading), and all roller sports. Sizes are as follows: (Runs a little small in my opinion) Junior – Includes Junior size wrist guards, knee pads and elbow pads Small – Includes adult size small wrist guards, and adult one size fits all knee and elbow pads Medium - Includes adult size medium wrist guards, and adult one size fits all knee and elbow pads Large - Includes adult size large wrist guards, and adult one size fits all knee and elbow pads Wristsavers Sizing Guidelines: To ensure a perfect wrist guard fit, measure hand circumference at the knuckles and match to the sizes listed below: Jr 7.0 – 7.5 inches S 7.5 – 8.0 inches M 8.0 – 9.0 inches L 9.0 – 10.0 inches
item.name: Triple Eight Saver Series High Impact 3 Pack of Pads - Black

item.name: Triple Eight Saver 3 Pack Of Pads - Mint

item.description: Vans Skate Authentic Mid is a straight forward Mid top skate shoe. Built with a suede and canvas upper, these shoes feature a durable Duracap underlay to protect against your flip tricks with the SickStick rubber outsole for maximum grip, and lined with the PopCush insole for optimal impact protection. Finished with the classic Vans Skate checkerboard woven flag label.
item.name: Vans Skate Authentic Mid Poppy Ember Red Shoes

item.description: Signature mid top shoe DuraCap™ is a thin rubber underlay designed specifically for skateboarding, placed in key areas to protect against griptape wear Lace-up closure for an adjustable fit Padded collar for support and comfort A molded heel counter provides structure support, improving stability and fit Internal tongue straps prevents it from sliding during movement SickStick™ rubber—our stickiest yet—keeps you glued to your board PopCush™ footbeds offer impact protection for extended skating Signature waffle outsole pattern for reliable grip since '66 Suede upper for a soft, textured finish
item.name: Vans Skate Half Cab Black Mustard Shoes

item.description: Dick Rizzo’s been skating the Half Cab for years, but lately you can find him in the streets in the all-new Skate Half Cab WaffleCup™. An updated take on one of the most iconic skate shoes of all time, with softer padding around the ankle, and our best-of-both-worlds WaffleCup outsole for the perfect blend of cupsole support and vulcanized boardfeel. To celebrate these upgrades, we let Dick put his own spin on a custom colorway. First, we added ripstop panels for further reinforcement, then Dick added some personal touches—with his photography printed on the insole, and the “Rizzo” signature stamped on the heel.
item.name: Vans Skate Half Cab Waffle Cup Rizzo Shoes

item.description: From the streets of Vancouver to spots all over the world, Una Farrar’s been rocking the Skate Half Cab for years. Now, we’re taking her favorite shoe to the next level with a WaffleCup™ outsole for the perfect blend of cupsole support and vulcanized boardfeel. Una put a personal touch on her custom Skate Half Cab WaffleCup colorway with personalized design details, including a photo of her childhood home printed on the insole and four-leaf clover eyelets for a bit of luck.
item.name: Vans Skate Half Cab Waffle Cup Una Shoes

item.description: First released in 1977, the Old Skool—was just the second skate shoe we ever made. Designed with input from the pioneers of skateboarding, the Old Skool’s first-of-its-kind suede toe cap and durable rubber stood up to the wear-and-tear of griptape (a relatively new addition to most skateboards in the '70s). By the standards of the day, the Old Skool was the most progressive shoe on the market, and literally took skateboarders to the next level. Today's Skate Old Skool continues this heritage of progression and remains one of our most popular shoes. It's as durable as ever and skateable right out of the box—reinforced and refined with PopCush™ impact protection, DuraCap™ underlays, and grippy SickStick™ rubber.
item.name: Vans Skate Old Skool Soft Slate Blue Shoes

item.description: Skate slip-on icon Elastic side panels for easy slip-on and off PopCush™ footbeds offer impact protection for extended skating DuraCap™ underlays add extra durability and protection to high-wear areas for shoe longevity SickStick™ rubber—our stickiest yet—keeps you glued to your board Padded collar for support and comfort Signature waffle sole pattern outsole for reliable grip since '66 Vulcanized sole for superior board feel and flexibility Suede upper
item.name: Vans Skate Slip-On Black Red Shoes
